title: INT8 weight-only: fuzz-driven calibration suite and smoke guardrails
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an automated validation pipeline that fuzz-tests INT8 weight-only (WO) quantization profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants), verifies calibration stability, and provides fast smoke guardrails for canary rollouts. The suite will run in CI/nightly and produce deterministic golden-seed snapshots, per-model sensitivity matrices, and automated alerts for quality drift above configurable thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Fuzz suite runs end-to-end in CI and completes within compute budget for nightly (max 6 hours).
For 10 representative models (small/med/large), coverage includes short/long context and sampling modes (greedy, top-k, nucleus).
Calibration artifacts (scale/zero-point candidates) are recorded to the quant-profile registry with metadata tags and seed information.
Regression gate: if BLEU/ROUGE/MAULT metric drop > 2% vs baseline or embedding cosine < 0.985 on eval sets, pipeline flags a failure and opens a blocking PR.
Canary job integration: smoke guardrail must run within canary window and provide pass/fail signal to rollout controller.
steps: Design fuzz corpus: combine 5 internal prompt suites + obfuscated real-prod-sample subset (privacy-scrubbed).
Implement mutation operators: token-drop, prefix-shift, numeric-perturbation, prompt-padding, adversarial-templating.
Integrate GPTQ/AWQ patch hooks to apply weight-only transforms and capture per-layer quantization stats.
Create golden-seed harness: deterministic RNG seeds + fixed batching to ensure reproducible metric snapshots.
Add telemetry: per-request token-level loss delta, KV cache hit ratios, and quantized-kernel fallback counters.
Wire up CI jobs and nightly schedule; add dashboard panels and alert rules for drift thresholds.
